item.title: CVE-2026-16720 [CVSS:3.1 9.8 CRITICAL]
item.description:
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain valid access tokens for other users due to improper authentication. Authentication against a connected directory service is not sufficiently enforced, which could allow another user's identity to be assumed.

item.title: CVE-2026-110516

item.title: CVE-2026-114432 [CVSS:3.1 9.8 CRITICAL]
item.description:

On other configurations, including nginx and Apache with .htaccess overrides enabled, the issue is limited to an arbitrary file written into the uploads directory, which may still be served as active content such as HTML or SVG from the site's own origin.
